notes.title: ARISEN new game update, OST release and ARISEN purchase
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/13dbe5e1b5a0a358f553cd281df1d265971817d5.png

Hello everyone! 

Here’s Ben from Homecoming Studio: You may remember me as I worked with Maratus on the marketing and producing side, from the Kickstarter to the end. 
Today I’m writing on the Homecoming Studio behalf:  We’re happy to share that we have bought back ARISEN since the bankruptcy of Maratus! 
A good way to keep the game in the hands of people that worked on the production. :) 

I’m sure your next question is: What will be the future for ARISEN? 

So far here’s our roadmap: 

This week: 
- We will release a new game update! It will contains a few bugfixes that improve stability and the overall game visual experience. It’s the last patch made by the Maratus team. You will find the patch note after. 

- We’re ready to publish the Original Soundtrack composed by Yann Rayon, we will send it to the Kickstarter Backers this week. By the end of the month, the soundractk will be available on other musical streaming platforms. We are also thinking about publishing it on Steam too and we would like to hear from you: do you want it here too? 

- We will also take down the Prologue Version. The purpose was initially to support the Kickstarter campaigns and get a maximum of feedback from our community (you!). But as we have now the demo on our main Steam Page, we want to avoid spreading the traffic, or maintain the content there. 
You will continue to have access to the prologue for free by downloading the demo version on the main page.

In the next month:
Our wish is to releae one way or another the end of ARISEN in the future. That's why our current plan is to retain as much money we can from the sales. At the moment, it is insufficient to cover the development cost for the Act3. Which means the development of Act 3 is officially on hold. 

We are looking for partners or deals to continue the development further and maybe release the game on other platforms than Steam. I'll keep you posted on what happens next! 

We still definitely need your support. So please, do not hesitate to share the game around you and recommend it to your friends, family, colleagues or your favourite streamers!
Also, do not hesitate to leave a positive review on Steam or to wishlist it if you don't already own the game. It will boost our visibility on the store!

Wish you the best, thank you for your support!
Ben.

notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/2425ef29706f3e377f5150ae0b49907b3d1f6f2c.png

Hello everyone! ❤️

Today is a big day! We can announce that ARISEN’s Act 2 is fully playable!

It’s a whole new part of the story to read! Hope you will like it, let us know!

You will meet again with Igweneil, Rahis, Waard, Viziriad… The Love and Hate cards will be available. Who would you like to kiss? Shall you have a rival? 

What are the Mehve’s plans for the future? Where is Tarak? Will you make good choices to meet the pirate queen Aridiel?

And that’s it for the main part of the update, but it also comes with fixes that you will find in the patch note here. 

We're always listening to your feedback, please use the bug report tool with the F8 key in game or you can still reach us on our Discord. 


Have a nice week travelers ❤️

notes.title: Early Access Patch #2

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/3ca0e88e4c21fe2437da2a39173ce324860471d2.png

Hello everyone! ❤️

We are here with some good news!

We have just released a new patch for ARISEN. What kind of changes have we made?

 Multiple backgrounds bug who come on top of the previous ones should be fixed,
 The journal is finally back (yeah!), check the cards you unlocked in it, the log files and your character sheet with your current relationship with the mains characters,
 A time feature has been added: starting now the background will have a night and day cycle. 
You can now unlock the Act 1 epilogue after the quests of Igweneil and Baeli, instead of the quests of the 6 main characters, which simplify the replayability of the game.
Be careful: you won’t be able to complete these quests before starting the second Act of the game. 

And that’s it for the main part of the update, but it also comes with many fixes that you will find in the patch note here. 

And for the good news, we shall be back to you very soon to reveal the acte 2 release date!

We're still listening to your feedback, please use the bug report tool with the F8 key in game or you can still reach us on our Discord. 

Have a nice week travelers ❤️
The Maratus team

notes.title: Release date reveal + beta info
notes.notes:
Once again, we’re here to give you thrilling news: ARISEN will be released on Early Access on 21st September! We can’t wait to be finally here and have your feedback about the game. If you want to support us again, feel free to share the news!

Also for every backer who had pledged for the game reward, you will be able to play the beta tomorrow (yes, you read that well), 4 days before the big day. So the whole first act, excluding the epilogue for now, shall be available for you to play this week-end! 

It’s a gift from us for the release in early access and the game being delayed several times.

Below you will find more information about the beta and some various facts about the project. 

[previewyoutube=lzZtCsW6nYk;full][/previewyoutube]

📜 About the beta:

Tomorrow you will receive a Steam key by mail from us! 

If you think you don't receive it, wait a couple of hours or please check your spam folder. If you still don't have it, contact us at support@maratusgames.com or on Discord if you struggle to get your key. Please remember to write to us with the same email you used during the Kickstarter or the late pledge!

Here is how you can activate a key on Steam:
https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/2A12-9D79-C3D7-F870

📜 About the beta content:

You will have access to almost all the first act the same way as Early Access. The missing part, the epilogue, shall be added a few weeks after the early access release.

You may have some bugs! To help us with them, you can signal any problem to us thanks to the F8 button directly in-game. You can also join our Discord server to give us detailed feedback in the dedicated channels.

📜 The physical awards?

If you're a backer, you've probably already noticed that COVID has made things very complicated. So we are taking much more time than expected on this aspect! There is still time to change your address or complete CrowdOx if you haven't already done so.

📜 Internal changes?

We have two departures to announce in the core team: Elene, our Art Director, and Sylvain, our Game Designer, left Maratus. We also have to thank My-Loan that will end this trainee period at Maratus in a few weeks.
We wish them all the best for the future and thank them for their work in ARISEN!

See you soon in Var'Nagal! 

The ARISEN Team. 💖

notes.title: ARISEN roadmap update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!💖

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/0f2237922b658aca22a2fb2c81e07771d1b571e9.png

It’s been a while since we last wrote something to you, and for a good reason: a lot of things are happening on our side! We have a lot of topics, bad as well as good, on the agenda today!

First of all, let’s check the roadmap first: we had previously announced a playtesting session in May/June (with the Steam Next Fest demo to end this session). To be honest, we haven’t launched a first playtest session yet. Still, we got plenty of useful feedback on the June demo, so many thanks for your comments!
Of course, we’re still planning to do some playtests sessions: the first sessions should start by the end of summer. More than a hundred of you have signed up for them, which makes us very happy!

You may think, “that’s great but we want to be able to play the full game, not the playtest version. So when will we be able to play ARISEN?” 

We made an important decision for the future of the game, and it was not an easy one. A while back, we asked you on Discord what would you prefer for the release. We finally decided to release the game in Early Access on Steam in the coming weeks (yes, weeks!). Even if we would have preferred to let you play the whole game from start to the end, the financial realities caught up with us. So we’ve decided to release the game into 3 pieces, Act by Act. It’s allowing us to improve the game step by step between these big releases. 


Why will you release the game in Early Access?


There are several reasons behind why. Financial reasons on one hand (more than 2 years without any income) and on the other hand, the impact of the covid both on our providers and partners. Of course, our organisation itself suffered from it (almost everyone is working remotely now). There are also internal changes that had to be considered, which we will discuss in a later update. 

What does this mean for backers? 

As promised, for those who have a pledge with the beta reward, we will give you access to a beta version of the game (on Steam) during these next weeks. It will include the entire First Act playable, in English and French. This version will evolve through different patches to become the Early Access version. Then, we will add Act 2 or 3 later on, at no extra cost for all those who already have a key to the game (from Kickstarter or purchase on Steam). 

For those who have a pledge with the game, we’ll send you a Steam key as soon as Early Access will be released. 

What is the current state of the game’s development?

All the textual and visual content for the Act 1 is done. Concerning the Act 2, the script is currently being translated and the art content is almost completed. About the Act 3, the story script is almost finished while the art team is about to finish the last backgrounds and remaining characters. 

The team is busy focusing on testing and integrating all the systems in ARISEN. Since we want the game to be like a gamebook, we want it to be as non-linear as possible. These game’s systems are crucial in providing the sense of freedom we want. It’s where we still have so much work to do, and that’s what we will focus on during the early access. 

What’s next?

We’ll keep you updated on the next big steps (such as the early access release date). Meanwhile, please remember to fill your crowdox information, especially as we will need your emails to send your Steam keys soon! Of course if you have to change your address, it should be possible to change it. 

Of course, thank you for your support and patience! 

Before leaving you, here’s a little preview, a first image of the launch trailer we’re working on!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/103cc18cadebd7220d75d7162fcbf012cd48b3ae.png

The Maratus team.

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign + Prologue new patch change log
notes.notes:
Hello travellers!

Today is an important day for the team: our Kickstarter campaign is live and you now have the possibility to help us!

[previewyoutube=UTK-Dd4aO7k;full][/previewyoutube]
But why Kickstarter and why do you need our support?

70% of our development budget is already funded.

Your support here on Kickstarter enables us to finance the full development of ARISEN! We want to have the chance to add the missing features and illustrations, to offer more and more story content, and of course to give ARISEN the best English translation.

We also want to work with our community to get as much feedback as early as possible to make our game the visual novel the gamers actually want. Don’t be shy! Tell us what you like in the alpha demo, share your opinion with us. We love interacting with players, whether it be on Discord or social media!

We can make the dark fantasy narrative game you are waiting for! 
You can support us here: Arisen Kickstarter
